subject: general
question:
**Direction: Parts of the following sentence are given as options. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

This newspaper has a bigger circulation from any other newspaper in our town.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'from any other newspaper​.'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The part 'from any other newspaper​' is incorrect as it is grammatically incorrect.
 
• In this sentence, we are comparing the circulation of two newspapers.
 
• Hence, we need a **comparative degree** to show the comparison.
 
• Therefore, the use of 'from any other newspaper​' in the sentence should be replaced with 'than any other newspaper' to make it grammatically correct.
 
• Thus, the correct option is 'from any other newspaper​.'
 
• ​​The correct sentence__: *This newspaper has a bigger circulation **than any other newspaper** in our town.*

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 

__
 
• For can be used with all tenses.

 
 
• Example: *They study for two hours every day.

 They are studying for three hours today.

 He has lived in Bangkok for a long time.

 He has been living in Paris for three months.*
 
 
 
• Since is normally used with perfect tenses.
 
 
• Example: *He has been here since 9 am.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__** 

 
• भाग 'from any other newspaper​' गलत है क्योंकि यह व्याकरणिक रूप से गलत है।
 
• इस वाक्य में हम दो समाचार पत्रों के प्रचलन की तुलना कर रहे हैं।
 
• इसलिए, हमें तुलना दिखाने के लिए comparative degree की आवश्यकता है।
 
• इसलिए वाक्य में 'from any other newspaper​' के प्रयोग को व्याकरण की दृष्टि से सही बनाने के लिए 'than any other newspaper​' से प्रतिस्थापित किया जाना चाहिए।
